pricingPage.title: Pricing
pricingPage.subtitle: How pricing works for domestic staff and home repair services through RX Direct.
pricingPage.intro: There's no fixed price list, because a live-in cook in a large household and a part-time cleaner for a small apartment simply cost different amounts. Instead, we quote based on your specific requirements after a short WhatsApp conversation, so you always know the exact cost before you commit to anything.
pricingPage.noHidden: Whatever the quote, there are no hidden charges added later, the price we confirm with you upfront is the price you pay, and it only applies once a placement is confirmed.
pricingPage.categoriesText: Household staff (cooks, chefs, maids, helpers, cleaners, nannies, gardeners) are typically priced by whether the role is live-in, live-out or part-time. Office and security staff (drivers, guards, office boys) are usually quoted per month, with adjustments for extra duties like overtime driving. Nursing and care staff (home nurses, caretakers) are priced by shift length and the level of medical or personal care involved. Home repair and trade staff (electricians, plumbers, carpenters, painters) can be booked per visit for a single repair or on a recurring maintenance basis, whichever suits your situation better.
pricingPage.salaryTableSubtitle: A transparent guide to starting monthly salaries by staff category. Your final quote depends on experience, live-in/live-out arrangement and city.
pricingPage.salaryTableNote: Figures are starting salaries in PKR for entry-to-mid-level experience. Highly experienced candidates, specialist skills or premium cities may cost more, we'll always confirm the exact number before you commit.

If you have experience in any of the roles we place, cooking, driving, cleaning, childcare, nursing, caretaking, or a skilled trade like electrical work, plumbing, carpentry or painting, we'd like to hear from you.
